skill_contract.semantic_judge_policy: Judge the observable Mission contract and handoff, not exact headings, wording, length, dialogue count, or a preferred implementation. In the retained packet, each user-visible answer is at turns[].executor_final.response; there is intentionally no top-level response field. workspace_directories is the complete final directory inventory and may be used to decide directory-side-effect criteria. Do not require a response to repeat names already explicit in the same-turn user prompt when it unambiguously refers to them and no durable artifact is being written. Do not require generic policy boilerplate when the observable contract already satisfies that policy. Do not fail because an optional supporting-check category is not named when the required result-level proof remains explicit and proxy proof is not made sufficient. Binding content must follow adopted decisions and applicable authority. Material known facts must remain durably recoverable with their actual authority status; candidate routes must remain optional. A result contract must not replace another requested product. Compactness is semantic: every retained clause should change the contract, proof, boundary, authority, or durable handoff. Fail invented authority, lost adopted meaning, transient-only material context, unnecessary ceremony, route overconstraint, invalid Mission topology, or a blind handoff that cannot recover the result. Return INCONCLUSIVE when decisive evidence is unavailable.
